fm.title: Mppi controllers
fm.description: Model-predictive path integral controllers for various vehicle types (4 blocks)

rows.intent: Model-predictive path integral controller for Ackermann-steered vehicles — use for sampling-based trajectory optimization in offroad navigation
MPPI controller for articulated-steering vehicles — use for trajectory optimization of wheel loaders or articulated dump trucks
MPPI controller using bicycle kinematic model — use for sampling-based trajectory optimization of car-like vehicles in offroad settings
MPPI controller for differential-drive vehicles — use for sampling-based trajectory optimization of skid-steer or tracked robots

fm.title: Simulation 3d
fm.description: 3D visualization and virtual sensor simulation for offroad scenarios (5 blocks)

rows.intent: Spawn a physics-enabled 3D backhoe in the simulation scene — use for simulating excavation operations with realistic articulated arm dynamics
Spawn a physics-enabled 3D dump truck in the simulation scene — use for simulating loading and hauling operations with bed tilt dynamics
Attach a virtual camera sensor in the 3D simulation scene — use for generating synthetic camera images for perception algorithm development
Attach a virtual lidar sensor in the 3D simulation scene — use for generating synthetic point clouds for offroad perception testing
Configure the 3D simulation environment and scene — use for selecting terrain, weather, and lighting conditions for offroad simulation
